row.evidence: Paycom's security FAQ says "We also offer SAML 2.0 (SSO) so clients can manage through their chosen identity provider application", but no Paycom page documents SCIM or automated provisioning, and pricing is a custom quote for Core or Complete.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM documented at any tier. Pricing is quote-only ("each quote is customized to the functionality a company needs and the number of employees"; Core is the minimum, Complete adds tools). SAML 2.0 SSO is offered (security page) but the package that includes it is not stated, so sso_plan is null. Paycom is an HR system of record and markets its single database with "no APIs or third-party consultants"; no public developer API was found. Not in the Okta catalogue (search returns nothing) or the Entra tutorial index. Confidence low: Paycom's help centre is login-only, so the absence search could not cover it.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented on paycom.com (pricing, security, IT decision-maker pages, sitemap, llms.txt); Paycom is not in the Okta catalogue or the Entra tutorial index. Left null (Paycom never says no); status none by absence.

audit_log_api.notes: An in-app, non-purged audit trail (user ID, time/date, IP) is documented; no API for it.

user_api.notes: No public developer portal or API reference found. The pricing page markets "value over time with no APIs or third-party consultants" (single-database design), which is not an explicit statement that no API exists.

okta.notes: OIN search for "paycom" returns no results.

entra.notes: No Paycom entry in the Entra SaaS tutorial index (learn.microsoft.com toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: No public admin/help documentation; Paycom help sits inside the client login.
